sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: Legacy evidence supports limestone and sandstone sport climbing, including well-known areas around Málaga/El Chorro and Granada/Cádiz.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The source mix supports sport and multipitch climbers, but the region should be split for precise buyer-facing recommendations.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Legacy taxonomy reports about 3,600 routes, but no reliable region-wide gradeRange is assigned.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: Legacy evidence supports autumn through spring and warns that summer can be prohibitively hot on south-facing walls.
